2609.11244.title: OmniHallu: Unified Hallucination Detection for Cross-Modal Comprehension and Generation in Multimodal Large Language Models
2609.11244.paper_summary: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress across diverse tasks, they suffer from hallucinations where generated outputs contradict or misrepresent input semantics. Existing research typically addresses hallucination detection within a single modality or task type, limiting generalizability. We introduce OmniHallu, a unified hallucination detection framework spanning both comprehension and generation tasks across image, video, and audio modalities. We contribute OmniHallu-Bench, a 10,000-sample benchmark with claim-level human annotations covering six cross-modal tasks: image-to-text (I2T), video-to-text (V2T), audio-to-text (A2T), text-to-image (T2I), text-to-video (T2V), and text-to-audio (T2A). Our multi-agent architecture decomposes model outputs into atomic claims, verifies them through modality-specific experts, and aggregates evidence via structured reasoning. We further propose a preference-optimized trainable verifier that approximates the multi-agent decision boundary, reducing expert calls by 66% with minimal performance loss. Extensive experiments reveal a consistent modality-dependent performance gradient and provide fine-grained insights into cross-modal hallucination patterns.
2609.11244.paper_summary_zh: 儘管多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）在各種任務上取得了顯著的進展，但它們仍然面臨著產生的輸出與輸入語義相矛盾或誤表述的幻覺問題。現有研究通常僅針對單一模態或任務類型的幻覺檢測，限制了其普遍適用性。我們介紹了OmniHallu，一個統一的幻覺檢測框架，涵蓋了圖像、視頻和音頻模態下的理解和生成任務。我們貢獻了OmniHallu-Bench，一個包含10,000個樣本的基準，並提供了涵蓋六個跨模態任務的聲明級人類標註：圖像到文本（I2T）、視頻到文本（V2T）、音頻到文本（A2T）、文本到圖像（T2I）、文本到視頻（T2V）和文本到音頻（T2A）。我們的多代理架構將模型輸出分解為原子聲明，通過特定模態的專家進行驗證，並通過結構化推理聚合證據。我們進一步提出了一個偏好優化的可訓練驗證器，該驗證器近似多代理決策邊界，將專家調用減少66%，且性能損失最小。大量實驗顯示出一致的模態依賴性能梯度，並提供了對跨模態幻覺模式的細緻洞察。
